text:
amanda: hey team, quick pitch: 'Community Code Dojo' -> 3 weekly micro-tutorials + 1 lightweight refapp + a live mentor-led workshop. looking to ship a concise launch post, tutorial cadence, refapp repo, webinar funnel, and inbound routing. short checklist below.

james: sounds strong. can we adapt the tiny-refapp template to save dev time?

sara: yes pls. i'll draft 3 lab outlines (each ~15-25 minutes). aim to have drafts by Fri COB.

leo: i'll fork starter-kit and add a minimal README + quickstart script. ETA Tue morning.

amanda: webinar format idea: 40min total: 20m live build, 15m q&a, 5m next steps + community plug. landing page needs gated form + UTM tracking. who owns landing + email flow?

anna: i'll take landing + email drip. proposed drip: confirmation, 24h reminder, 1d follow-up with repo + next labs. will add UTMs and HubSpot tags.

nora: inbound routing proposal: attendees -> nurture list; if they complete >50% of tutorials or click "talk to sales" link, route to SE queue. tag leads with `dojo_interest` and primary use-case tag.

james: also add a Slack CTA in post to join #code-dojo for live workshop chat.

amanda: marketing-bot, create a review task for the launch post next Wed.

marketing-bot: task created: /tasks/4876 assigned to @amanda @anna @sara. review due Wed 09:00 PT.

leo: quick metrics to track: landing views, signups, webinar RSVPs vs. attendees, tutorial completions, refapp stars, MQLs created. set Amplitude + HubSpot dashboards.

sara: content file layout i'll push to docs repo:
```
/tutorials/dojo/lab-1-getting-started.md
/tutorials/dojo/lab-2-optimizing-inference.md
/tutorials/dojo/lab-3-deployment-patterns.md
/refapps/community-code-dojo/README.md
/benchmarks/dojo-demo-blurb.md
```

james: i'll draft a short benchmark blurb comparing latency and cost for the demo prompt on small/dedicated tiers. should be ~3 sentences and a table snippet.

amanda: license: keep refapp MIT, add CONTRIBUTING.md for mentor notes and session guides.

anna: landing copy draft: "Ship a tiny refapp with Redwood Inference in 40 minutes. Join the Community Code Dojo." doc: https://docs.google.com/dojo-landing-draft — comments welcome.

sara: can we recruit 2 community mentors for live Q&A? i can reach out to volunteers list.

james: pinging Frank and Mira who have done similar events (ccing here).

amanda: ops note: webinar registration should auto-add attendees to the #code-dojo Slack invite flow. anna, can HubSpot webhook do that?

anna: yes, HubSpot -> Zapier -> Slack invite flow is set up. will add the workflow.

nora: after first cohort, run a 3-question NPS + 90s feedback form to collect improvement ideas and favorite labs.

leo: pushing initial repo now. will tag the draft with v0.1 and add quickstart script: `./run-local.sh`.

sara: reminder: tutorials must include reproducible prompts, a short benchmark note, and a "where to go next" section.

amanda: timeline recap: repo Tue, tutorials Fri, post review Wed, publish Thu, webinar + mentors 2 weeks after publish. sync Tue 10:30 PT.

anna: i'll also prepare the HubSpot lead scoring rule: add 10 points for webinar attendance, 20 if lab completion >50%.

james: i'll add the benchmark snippet to the docs and a small graph export for the launch post.

amanda: nice work team. TL;DR: ship refapp + labs this week, landing & emails by Fri, publish next Thu, run webinar 2w later. :rocket: 

marketing-bot: reminder scheduled: review sync Tue 10:30 PT.
